sample_data_caveats: Alpaca IEX feed is not consolidated SIP market data.
Universe uses current liquid NASDAQ leaders/theme ETF and may contain survivorship bias until PIT universe membership is added.
Selected route does not beat ex-post best single symbol; treat as router/risk-control candidate, not stock-selection alpha proof.
capacity_assessment: Target-weight mapping caps max gross exposure at 25% and single-name weight at 25%; latest order-required intents=557. Capacity is likely acceptable for small paper accounts, but paper_auto still needs TCA review against ADV/open volume and whole-share OPG/LOO sizing.
notes: Research gate passed on strict-live Alpaca IEX daily data from 2020-07-27 to 2026-05-21: OOS annualized 16.00%, OOS alpha vs TQQQ +11.78%, OOS Sharpe 1.28, OOS max drawdown -11.50%, 3/5 walk-forward folds positive. Warnings remain for multiple testing, factor diagnostics, IEX-vs-SIP data caveat, and ex-post best-symbol underperformance.
